quote: "Lucius Harben sat at his desk with his shoulders folded forward as if in sleep." (.writer/drafts/s-001.md)

value: deceased; apparent gunshot wound near hand
quote: "His chest was still. A neat, round mark on the wood, the kind a single shot makes, stained the blotter beside his hand." (.writer/drafts/s-001.md)
